name: An Italian public-service pension of an Italian citizen in Bellinzona, with a full AHV pension: it counts for the rate
workings: Entered with taxedIn: source, the Italian pension of an Italian citizen is read as a public-service pension, which Italy alone taxes (Italy-Switzerland treaty Art. 19, even with dual citizenship): Switzerland counts it only for the rate, and credits nothing.
Ticino: net income 32,760 - 5,500 = 27,260; the deduction for single people loses 2 x 1,000 above 21,000: 6,000; taxable 21,260.

At the rate of 51,260 (with the 30,000): tariff 3,096.0942, so the simple tax is 3,096.0942 x 21,260 / 51,260 = 1,284.099935; cantonal 100% = 1,284.099935, communal (Bellinzona, 93%) = 1,194.212940; personal tax 40.
